# Blackmoon 黑月

> Blackmoon (黑月) is a vinyl-only hi-fi listening bar on Beiluoguxiang (北锣鼓巷) in Beijing's Dongcheng hutongs, tucked behind a black door. It shares one roof with Ravens (乌鸦, kitchen, est. 2017) and 古耳 Gǔ Ěr (daytime specialty coffee). Records are hip-hop, soul/funk, jazz and City Pop. The venue hosts private events and buyouts (seated or standing), and provides off-site catering, mobile cocktail bars, and meal boxes (盒饭).

## Visit

- Address: No. 66 Beiluoguxiang, Dongcheng District, Beijing / 北京市东城区北锣鼓巷 66 号
- Bar (Blackmoon 黑月): Tue–Thu 18:00–01:00 · Fri–Sat 18:00–01:30 · Sun 18:00–01:00 · closed Monday
- Kitchen (Ravens 乌鸦): 18:00–22:00
- Coffee (古耳): daily 10:00–18:00
- Capacity: ~30–35 seated across the listening room and dining lounge · up to 50–60 standing
- Table reservations: WeChat RavensDomain · phone +86 186 1174 1214
- Private hire, events, catering & meal boxes: WeChat ruhaox · 1994ep@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/blackmoon.beijing/

## Private events (prices in RMB, service included, valid until 2027-03-31)

- Seated full venue buyout, 18:00–23:00 minimum spend on food & drinks (~30–35 seated): Tue–Thu ¥6,000 · Sun ¥8,000 · Fri–Sat ¥12,000 · peak dates enquire.
- Seated semi-private area (~12–18 seated): Tue–Thu ¥3,000 · Sun ¥4,000 · Fri–Sat ¥5,000 · peak dates enquire.
- Standing full venue buyout, 18:00–23:00 minimum spend (~50–60 standing): Tue–Thu ¥6,000 · Sun ¥8,000 · Fri–Sat ¥12,000 · peak dates enquire.
- Standing semi-private area (~20–30 standing): Tue–Thu ¥3,000 · Sun ¥4,000 · Fri–Sat ¥5,000 · peak dates enquire.
- Daytime hire 10:00–17:00: Tue–Thu ¥500/h, Fri–Sun ¥700/h, minimum 2 hours.
- Custom event menus: tailored to seated plated courses, family-style sharing feasts, or standing reception platters; 100% of minimum spend goes toward food & drinks.
- Off-peak: February and September, 20% off evening buyout minimums, plus a complimentary selector vinyl DJ set for full buyouts.
- Add-ons: selector vinyl DJ set ¥1,500 (2h) · bring your own DJ or band free · album listening session curation & host ¥800 · custom brand cocktail ¥800 (waived on spends ≥ ¥10,000) · extension past closing ¥800/h · wine corkage ¥100/bottle (no outside spirits) · own cake free · bespoke vinyl playlist or gift record curation (enquire).
- Deposit 50%. Cancel 7+ days ahead for a full refund. Final headcount 72 hours before.
- Quiet hours: from 22:00 music stays below 80 dB; no loud voices outdoors.

## Catering & meal boxes

- Off-site catering: ¥98 / ¥168 / ¥238+ per guest, min. 15 guests or ¥2,000, 5 days' notice, delivery within 5 km of Gulou.
- Meal boxes (盒饭): ¥68 / ¥98 / ¥138, min. 15 boxes, 2 days' notice; lunch 11:30–13:00 Tue–Fri, dinner 17:30–19:00.
- Mobile cocktail bar: ¥1,500 (1 bartender, 3h, up to 50 guests, ice & glassware included).
